title: Edit ticket category or group
purpose: Change a group's or a category's name, client label, routing and rules, or retire it, with a reason that is kept in its history.
summary: Change a group or a category and say why. Retiring one stops it being offered for new tickets. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Change a category
steps: Change the details, then write the [[Reason for change]].
Select [[Save changes]]. The list opens at the group.

tasks.title: Retire a category or group
steps: Clear [[Active]], give the reason and save. Existing tickets keep it.

tasks.title: Change the complaint or restricted rule
steps: Change [[Complaint: tickets follow the complaint rules]] or [[Restricted: visible only to the team's members and supervisors]].
Explain the change in [[Reason for change]] and save.

tasks.title: Rename a group
steps: Open the group from [[Edit group]], change the [[Group name]] or [[Client label]], give the reason and save.

good_to_know: A reason is needed for every change. A save with nothing changed is refused.
A change to the complaint or restricted rule is recorded as its own kind of change in the history.
A group has fewer fields than a category: no group, guidance, team, priority or rules.
If someone else changed it after you opened the form, saving is refused and your input stays. Reload and review first.

sections.title: Group form and category form
paragraphs: One page serves both. A group (opened from Edit group) has Group name, Client label, Active and Reason for change. A category (opened from its name) also has Group, Intake guidance, Default team, Default priority and the three rules. The key is not shown and never changes.

items.label: Group name / Category name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters. A category name must be unique within its group, ignoring case. Surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: Client label
items.description: Optional, up to 120 characters. The wording for client portal users; empty means the staff name.

items.label: Active
items.description: Clear to stop offering it for new tickets. Existing tickets keep it. An inactive group is hidden from the default list and its categories are no longer offered.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Required. Kept with the change in the history.

items.label: Group
items.description: Required. The active groups, plus the category's current group even if it is inactive. Choosing another group moves the category there. A category can only be in a group.

items.label: Intake guidance
items.description: Optional text kept with the category for staff who log a ticket in it.

items.label: Default team
items.description: Optional. Active teams, plus the current one even if it is inactive. Empty means the laboratory's default team. A newly chosen team must be active.

items.label: Default priority
items.description: Low, Normal, High or Urgent. Used for a new ticket in this category when none is given.

items.label: Clients may raise it in the portal
items.description: When on, client portal users can choose this category.

items.label: Complaint: tickets follow the complaint rules
items.description: When on, tickets created in this category are marked as complaints. Tickets that already exist keep what they had.

items.label: Restricted: visible only to the team's members and supervisors
items.description: When on, tickets in this category are visible only to members of their team and to supervisors.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Saves and returns to the list at the group. The change is audited with the person, time, reason and the values before and after. If a complaint or restricted rule changed it is recorded as a flag change; otherwise as an update. A save with no change is refused with Change at least one detail before saving.

items.label: Changed by someone else
items.description: If the record changed after you opened the form, saving is refused with a message to reload and review the current record.

items.label: Inactive notice
items.description: While the stored record is inactive the form shows a notice that it is not offered for new tickets and that existing tickets keep it.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to Ticket categories without saving.
